blocks.text: SINGAPORE–Alex Eala relished her experience playing close to home at the Singapore Open despite a letdown in the round of 16 on Thursday night. Visibly gutted, Eala still found a way to turn a tough loss into something positive. “It was a short but sweet trip. I definitely would have wanted to go further. Like every tournament, I want to go far,” said Eala, who crashed out of the WTA 500 event after a grueling three-set loss to unseeded Russian Tatiana Prozorova at Center Court that lasted for three hours and nine minutes.
